item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President supplies an authority clause and section heading, but this segment contains no operative action governing an agency or affecting legal rights.","evidence":"it is hereby ordered as follows"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and prescribes the membership of an internal presidential advisory council; this is executive organization rather than a substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"I hereby establish the President's Homeland Security Advisory Council (PHSAC)."},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President is directed to designate the council's chair and vice chair later, an internal staffing action with no dictated external legal outcome.","evidence":"The President shall designate a Chair and Vice Chair"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President and designated council officials establish, staff, and assign advisory and reporting functions to internal committees, with any further committees created at their discretion; these are organizational and advisory actions.","evidence":"The following four Senior Advisory Committees for Homeland Security (SACs) are hereby established to advise the PHSAC"},{"segment_id":"5","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines internal administration and delegation by agency heads, the Assistant, the Office of Administration, and the GSA Administrator with a present compensation-related entitlement to members and automatic termination of the bodies after two years.","evidence":"members shall be allowed travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence"}]}
